title: Para Bellum content: premade bundles
description: A bundle is a ROW THAT NAMES companies with counts. It is NOT a level, and it does not contain them: there are four levels and no fifth, and nothing in the hierarchy can hold a bundle (AD-M45). It is SEALED: taken whole or not at all, and nothing can extend or edit it (C920). Deviating is what the designer is for. How a bundle behaves in play is not settled by this file. File: Content/<namespace>/bundle.json.

name.description: What the player reads. Optional for a mod, required of shipped content (C802).

extends.description: NEVER LEGAL. Declared only so an attempt to edit a sealed bundle is refused by name (C920) rather than as a mere unknown key.

count.description: How many. Required in a file (the reader has no defaults, C101); a designer offers 1 for a new slot. It belongs to this slot, never to the thing named, so one design serves several parents at different counts.
